ideas.title: The Web of Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigating the connections between Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases and potential high-profile involvement.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate connections between entities and individuals
questions: What are the connections between the $250M scheme and the $46.6M autism care scam?
Are there any high-profile individuals involved?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme with high-profile involvement, potentially leading to significant consequences.
